name: effect-noise-resolve
title: Noise Resolve
description: Một đám hạt nhiễu phủ quanh chủ thể rồi thưa dần và tan, trong lúc chủ thể hết nhoè và đậm dần lên.

moworks.author: moworks

options.margin: px of grain field around the element (140)
options.exitAt: s after the start to fade (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Grain specks (1.6 px) in a disc ~64 px around the subject fade in over 250 ms while the subject shows at 20 %. Then over 1000 ms easeOutSine: speck opacity 0.85 -> 0 and count 420 -> 0, re-seeded 24 times / s (2 in 3 in the light ink colour, 1 in 3 accent); subject blur 8 px -> 0 and opacity 0.2 -> 1, all ending together. Exit 250 ms ease-in cubic. DOM keyframes also scale the subject 0.96 -> 1. Params: duration (1 s) · amount: độ đậm hạt (0.85) · blur (8 px) · seed. The grains are re-seeded 24 times a second.
moworks.titleVi: Hạt nhiễu tan, hình rõ dần
